notes: «سيار» and «يحيى بن سعيد» heard «عبادة بن الوليد» together; the text then gives each its own route to the father (Yahya's runs one step further, to the grandfather), so each is a group with the head repeated and a null tail (rule 3)
«قال بايعنا رسول الله» is the saying; the remarks of شعبة on the word «حيثما كان» are wording notes and are left out
